title: Todo Remaining Count
prompt: A React todo component receives todos from state and needs to show how many are still open. Write a helper that returns the number of todos whose completed value is false.

explanation.beginner:
Example: todoRemainingCount([{"id":"1","text":"Ship","completed":false},{"id":"2","text":"Rest","completed":true}]) produces 1. The result must follow this precise rule: A React todo component receives todos from state and needs to show how many are still open. Write a helper that returns the number of todos whose completed value is false. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns zero when all are complete”: input [[{"id":"1","text":"Done","completed":true}]] produces 0. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
